thread:
noah: Quick follow-up from the PM — I consolidated the streaming/chat reliability remediation items. We want clear owners for: proxy/client timeouts, truncated/partial detection + safe retry, reconnect/backoff state machine, and observability. Claim one + ETA.

ana: I'll take proxy & client timeouts. Plan: adaptive proxy read deadlines (based on 95th tail) + publish SDK keepalive/read-timeout guidance. ETA 2026-02-08.

li: I'll own truncated detection and safe retry. Emit `stream.truncated` with request_id and kv_checksum; add server-side best-effort retry when idempotent. Ticket REM-2026-99. ETA 2026-02-12.

gwen: I'll do reconnect/backoff in runtime. Limit resume attempts to 3, exponential backoff + jitter, per-session lock to avoid duplicate resumes, circuit-breaker on resume_fail_rate > 0.5%. ETA 2026-02-05. PR WIP.

noah: Observability: need dashboards+alerts for incomplete_streams, resume_fail_rate, proxy_tail_503. telemetry-bot, can you scaffold?

telemetry-bot: Will create Grafana folder `streams/reliability-watch` and add panels/alerts. Alert thresholds proposed: incomplete_streams > 0.04% (5m), resume_fail_rate > 0.3% (5m).

li: Example log that motivated detection rules:
```
2026-01-29T11:47:12Z req_id=0x9b2a stream_id=77 status=truncated tokens_streamed=214 expected=1024 err=EOF
2026-01-29T11:47:12Z req_id=0x9b2a reconnect=1 route=pool-eu-2 latency_ms=5210
2026-01-29T11:47:14Z req_id=0x9b2a final_status=client_closed reason=deadline
```
This repeats during high-load windows.

- R4: Dashboards+alerts — owner: telemetry-bot — due: 2026-02-01 — Dash path: streams/reliability-watch
- R5: Weekly watchlist sync — owner: noah — recurring Fridays 09:30 PT
